import json, os, tomllib, subprocess

partition = json.load(open('partition-D.json'))
progress = json.load(open('progress-D.json'))

# Find new toml files for our partition that aren't in progress
new_files = []
for tool in partition['tools']:

        continue
    toml_path = f'tools/{tool}.toml'

        data = tomllib.load(open(toml_path, 'rb'))
        cmds = len(data.get('command', []))

for tool in "g++" gacutil gcc gcore gcov gunzip gzcat gzexe groups halt hash hexdump hdiutil host hostinfo hostname httpd httpx htpasswd; do echo "$tool:$(which "$tool" 2>&1)"; done

# Check the preprocessed image sizes to see if there's a dimension mismatch
python3 -c "
import cv2
import os

base_dir = 'data/357a3238-f7a0-41cc-ae4b-64d3146b0b5c'
for subdir in ['preprocessed', 'aligned', 'originals']:
    print(f'=== {subdir} ===')
    d = os.path.join(base_dir, subdir)
    if os.path.exists(d):
        for f in sorted(os.listdir(d)):
            img = cv2.imread(os.path.join(d, f))
            if img is not None:
                print(f'  {f}: {img.shape}')
"

# Clean up the L4 instance — we'll use Together API for Llama-70B instead
kill 63581 2>/dev/null  # kill SSH tunnel
gcloud compute instances delete qwen-mutator3 --zone=us-east1-b --project=intracept --quiet 2>&1

# Create .icns from the 512px PNG using macOS sips + iconutil
mkdir -p /tmp/intracept.iconset
for size in 16 32 128 256 512; do
  sips -z $size $size src-tauri/icons/icon.png --out /tmp/intracept.iconset/icon_${size}x${size}.png 2>/dev/null
  double=$((size * 2))
  if [ $double -le 1024 ]; then
    sips -z $double $double src-tauri/icons/icon.png --out /tmp/intracept.iconset/icon_${size}x${size}@2x.png 2>/dev/null
  fi
done
iconutil -c icns /tmp/intracept.iconset -o src-tauri/icons/icon.icns 2>&1
ls -la src-tauri/icons/
